mechanism_narrative: A residential construction level (HOUST) exceeding 500 indicates robust housing market activity, which drives consumer spending growth and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when HOUST is above threshold.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 500, or Rank IC for HOUST as predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rising above 0.5% per annum signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in labor force (PAYEMS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate tightening labor market and rising inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and CPIAUCSL are rising, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and UNRATE < 5.0) indicates Federal Reserve rate hikes to combat inflation, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and UNRATE < 5.0, or Rank IC for joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 90 indicates strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when INDPRO is above threshold.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 90, or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real sales and services (RSAFS) exceeding 380,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 380,000, or Rank IC for RSAFS as predictor of 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 95 indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when INDPRO is above threshold.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 95, or Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 130,000) indicates strong employment growth and wage pressures, triggering inflation concerns and Federal Reserve rate hikes that reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 130,000, or Rank IC for joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
